finalText:
**Wrote `validate_email.py`.** All 28 self-test cases pass.

`is_valid_email(address)` checks the everyday shape: `<email>`. It catches double dots, dots at the edges, hyphens at the edges of a name, spaces, missing dots, and over-long parts.

It turns down a few rare-but-legal forms: quoted names, raw IP addresses, and non-English letters.

One thing worth knowing: this only checks the shape. To know a mailbox really exists, you have to send it mail.
